title: Commute alert
idea: Commute alert: One relevant disruption leads alternatives with source freshness
audience: People who need to check disruption within a mobile surface.
worksWellWhen: A time-sensitive trip needs a next decision
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic signal layout through its check disruption priority and explicit commitment contract: Stale data is labeled and safe alternatives remain visible
navigation: Commute alert keeps the current check disruption context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: One relevant disruption leads alternatives with source freshness
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to check disruption; a time-sensitive trip needs a next decision
composition.priority: Stale data is labeled and safe alternatives remain visible

imagery.role: Support the actual check disruption context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Prioritize disruption over decorative route illustration
Respect safe areas, native text scaling, keyboard intrusion and platform back behavior.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the commute alert structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no check disruption content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Stale data is labeled and safe alternatives remain visible
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized check disruption content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Stale data is labeled and safe alternatives remain visible
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active check disruption context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure on target devices; test interrupted/resumed state and low-memory restoration.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
